title: Warlord #51 DC Comics 1981 Mike Grell Reprints Warlord #1 1st Dragonsword
condition_description: Bright cover, light handling wear; light toning at the cover edges and on the back. Small handwritten "C-750" at the lower left of the front cover. See photos.
description:
The Warlord #51 (November 1981), DC Comics. Re-presents the "classic" Warlord #1, plus the brand-new Dragonsword backup feature. Mike Grell cover. 60 cent cover price.

Back cover: MPC Turbo Z-28 model kit ad.

Condition: bright with light handling wear and light toning at the edges and on the back cover. Small handwritten "C-750" at the lower left of the front cover (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
